findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_mcp · Private data: start_here, gec_open_demands, knowledge_search · Public sink: start_here, audit_mcp · Destructive: audit_mcp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_mcp · Private data: start_here, gec_open_demands, knowledge_search · Public sink: start_here, audit_mcp · Destructive: audit_mcp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_here" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
